# KM-134 — Web: agent confirmation page

**Lane:** app · **Complexity:** 2 · **Model:** codex · **Depends on:** KM-104, KM-120 · **Serializes with:** KM-130, KM-135, KM-172 (shared `matrix-browser.ts`, `main.tsx`, `application.ts`, `browser-api.ts`)
**Plan context (pinned):** [M1 plan](https://github.com/aiur-team/khala/blob/reset/m1-external-plan/docs/plans/2026-10-01-002-refactor-external-m1-thin-path-plan.md) · [contracts](https://github.com/aiur-team/khala/blob/reset/m1-external-plan/docs/build/m1/contracts.md) · [roster and graph](https://github.com/aiur-team/khala/blob/reset/m1-external-plan/docs/build/m1/roster.md)
**Exclusive write surfaces:** `apps/web/src/features/agent-confirm/**` (new). Additive edits only in `apps/web/src/composition/human/{routes.ts,mount.tsx,application.ts,browser-api.ts,matrix-browser.ts}`, `apps/web/src/main.tsx` and their tests.

## Outcome

A signed-in owner opens `/agent/confirm?joinId=<joinId>` and sees the agent's label, harness and channel name, then presses **Confirm**. The page confirms, polls status every second until the agent is `ready`, then calls `client.invite(roomId, agentUserId)` once from this browser's Matrix client. That invite carries the MSC4268 history bundle (KTD3). The visible states are review, connecting ("Keep this tab open" shows only here), done, and error. A signed-out visitor is sent to sign-in and returned to the page.

## Context and evidence

- Plan U11, KTD3, R4, R6, AE1. Flow F3 step 2: "The owner opens the link while signed in and confirms. The owner's browser then invites the agent with the channel's history."
- How the browser Matrix client is reached: the `MatrixClient` is private inside `MatrixRuntime.active` (`apps/web/src/composition/human/matrix-browser.ts:290-364`). It is exposed only through `MatrixBrowserPorts` (`:747`), and that type has **no invite method** at 5db209cc. This ticket adds one port. Ports reach routes this way: `main.tsx` builds `createHumanApplication({...ports})` (`apps/web/src/main.tsx:85-97`). `application.ts` spreads `ports` into every `HumanRouteContext` (`apps/web/src/composition/human/application.ts:250-251`). `mount.tsx` `renderRoute(context, route)` hands the context to the route (`apps/web/src/composition/human/mount.tsx:302-323`).
- `client.invite` in matrix-js-sdk 42.4.0 shares room history only when the room's visibility is `shared` (KM-130) and the inviter's identity is self-verified (KM-130's `ensureCrossSigning`). Neither is a compile-time dependency of this ticket.
- Signed-out handling already exists: `SignInPanel` calls `identity.beginSignIn(path)`, which returns to `path` (`mount.tsx:75-102`; `browser-api.ts:231-236`).
- The SPA serves `/agent/*` through the `/* → /index.html` rule (`netlify.toml:61-63`).

2. A browser API client for the three C2 human endpoints.

4. The feature controller and screen.
5. Mount wiring, including auto sign-in for this route.

## Contract and invariants

From contracts.md **C2** (verbatim, the human half):

```ts
export type Harness = 'claude' | 'codex';

// GET  /api/human/agent-join?joinId=<joinId>          (human session cookie)
export type AgentJoinView = { joinId: string; label: string; harness: Harness; channelName: string; roomId: string;
  state: 'pending' | 'confirmed' | 'ready' | 'expired'; agentUserId?: string };
// errors: 401 signed_out ; 403 not_member ; 404 not_found

// POST /api/human/agent-join/confirm?joinId=<joinId>  (human session cookie + CSRF header as other human POSTs)
// body: {} → 200 AgentJoinView (state 'confirmed', agentUserId set). Idempotent for the same owner; 409 already_confirmed_by_other.

// GET  /api/human/agent-join/status?joinId=<joinId>   → 200 AgentJoinView   (browser polls every 1s until state === 'ready')
```

Errors are `{ "error": <code> }` with the HTTP status shown.

Import `AgentJoinView` and `Harness` from `@khala/contracts/m1/agent-join` (KM-104). Validate response bodies with `decodeAgentJoinView` (KM-104; it returns `Decoded<AgentJoinView>`, so check `.ok`). Do not write a second validator.

C2 preamble (verbatim):

> - **Confirm URL.** The `confirmUrl` is `<app origin>/agent/confirm?joinId=<joinId>`.

So the page path is `/agent/confirm` with exactly one query parameter, `joinId` (reconciliation A1). KM-131 builds the URL; this ticket routes it.

Invariants:
- Confirm is POSTed at most once per press. A retry after a timeout only re-polls status and never re-confirms (U11).
- `invite` is called at most once per successful `ready`. If the agent is already `invite`/`join` in the room, the invite is skipped and treated as success.

### Worked example

```
GET  /api/human/agent-join?joinId=j_7Qx2  → 200 {"joinId":"j_7Qx2","label":"Claude","harness":"claude","channelName":"Launch","roomId":"!r1:khala.local","state":"pending"}
     screen: "Claude (Claude Code) wants to join Launch."  [Confirm]
POST /api/human/agent-join/confirm?joinId=j_7Qx2  {}  (x-khala-csrf)
     → 200 {...,"state":"confirmed","agentUserId":"@agent-1a2b3c4d-x9y8z7:khala.local"}
     screen: connecting — "Connecting Claude… Keep this tab open."
GET  /api/human/agent-join/status?joinId=j_7Qx2  (every 1000 ms) → confirmed, confirmed, … → {"state":"ready","agentUserId":"@agent-1a2b3c4d-x9y8z7:khala.local",...}
     inviteAgent('!r1:khala.local','@agent-1a2b3c4d-x9y8z7:khala.local') → true
     screen: done — "Claude joined Launch."  [Open channel] → /channels/!r1%3Akhala.local
```

### Steps

1. **ports.ts**:
   ```ts
   export type AgentJoinError = 'signed_out' | 'not_member' | 'not_found' | 'already_confirmed_by_other' | 'unavailable';
   export type AgentJoinResult = { kind: 'ok'; view: AgentJoinView } | { kind: 'error'; code: AgentJoinError };
   export interface AgentJoinPort { view(joinId: string, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<AgentJoinResult>; confirm(joinId: string, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<AgentJoinResult>; status(joinId: string, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<AgentJoinResult>; }
   export type AgentInvitePort = (roomId: string, agentUserId: string) => Promise<boolean>;
   ```
2. **routes.ts**:
   - Add `| Readonly<{ kind: 'agent_confirm'; path: string; joinId: string }>`.
   - Add `agentConfirmPath(joinId)`, which returns `${base}/agent/confirm?joinId=${encodeURIComponent(joinId)}` (`base` + KM-104's `agentConfirmPagePath`).
   - In `parse`, accept pathname exactly `${base}/agent/confirm` whose search has exactly one key, `joinId`, appearing once, with a value matching `/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}$/`; anything else is `not_found`. Keep `path` as pathname + search.
   - Add `agentConfirmPath` to `HumanRouteCodec`.
3. **browser-api.ts**: add `agentJoin: AgentJoinPort` to `HumanBrowserApi` and the returned object.
   - `view` and `status` use `GET` with `credentials: 'same-origin'` and `requestSignal`.
   - `confirm` uses `mutation(path, {}, signal)`.
   - Map responses: 200 plus a valid view → `ok`; 401 → `signed_out`; 403 → `not_member`; 404 → `not_found`; 409 → `already_confirmed_by_other`; anything else, an invalid body, or a thrown error → `unavailable`.
   - Build paths with KM-104's `humanAgentJoinPath`, `humanAgentJoinConfirmPath` and `humanAgentJoinStatusPath` (each encodes `joinId` as `?joinId=`).
4. **matrix-browser.ts**: export `async function inviteWithHistory(client: Pick<MatrixClient, 'getRoom' | 'invite'>, roomId: string, userId: string): Promise<boolean>`.
   - `false` if the room is missing or not encrypted, or `userId` does not match `/^@[^:\s]+:\S+$/`.
   - `true` without inviting if `room.getMember(userId)?.membership` is `'invite'` or `'join'`.
   - Otherwise `await client.invite(roomId, userId)` → `true`; on a thrown error → `false`.
   - Add `inviteAgent(roomId: RoomId, userId: string): Promise<boolean>` to `MatrixBrowserPorts`; it calls `inviteWithHistory(runtime.active.client, …)` and returns `false` when there is no active client.
5. **application.ts**: add optional ports `readonly agentJoin?: AgentJoinPort;` and `readonly inviteAgent?: AgentInvitePort;` to `HumanApplicationPorts`. Import types from `../../features/agent-confirm/ports`.
6. **main.tsx**: pass `agentJoin: api.agentJoin, inviteAgent: matrix.inviteAgent` into `createHumanApplication`.
7. **controller.ts** — `createAgentConfirmController({ joinId, port, invite, pollMs = 1000, readyTimeoutMs = 60_000, now?, setTimer? })`. Use injected timers so tests are fake-timer driven.
   - Snapshot states:
     - `loading`
     - `review(view)`
     - `connecting(view)`
     - `done(view)`
     - `error({ code: AgentJoinError | 'expired' | 'ready_timeout' | 'invite_failed', view? })`
   - API: `start()`, `confirm()`, `retry()`, `subscribe`, `getSnapshot`, `dispose`.
   - `start()` calls `view`:
     - `pending` → `review`.
     - `confirmed` → `connecting`, and start polling.
     - `ready` → run the invite step.
     - `expired` → `error(expired)`.
     - Any error code → `error(code)`.
   - `confirm()` is accepted only in `review`. It sets `connecting`, then POSTs `confirm` once; `ok` → poll, and an error → `error(code)`.
   - Poll every `pollMs` with `status`:
     - `ready` with `agentUserId` → invite.
     - `expired` → `error(expired)`.
     - After `readyTimeoutMs` → `error(ready_timeout)`.
   - Invite: `await invite(view.roomId, view.agentUserId)`; `true` → `done`, `false` → `error(invite_failed)`.
   - `retry()`: from `ready_timeout` it restarts polling (never confirm); from `invite_failed` it re-runs the invite only.
8. **AgentConfirm.tsx**: render the snapshot inside `KhalaPageFrame` with the title "Confirm agent".
   - Harness names: `claude` → "Claude Code", `codex` → "Codex".
   - Review: "<label> (<harness name>) wants to join <channelName>." plus a `Confirm` button.
   - Connecting: `role="status"` "Connecting <label>… Keep this tab open."
   - Done: "<label> joined <channelName>." plus an `Open channel` link (props: `roomHref`, `onOpenRoom`).
   - Error copy:
     - `not_member` → "You are not a member of this channel."
     - `not_found` → "This confirmation link is not valid."
     - `expired` → "This request expired. Ask your agent to run khala_join again."
     - `already_confirmed_by_other` → "Another member already confirmed this agent."
     - `ready_timeout` → "The agent did not finish connecting." plus `Retry`.
     - `invite_failed` → "Could not add the agent to the channel." plus `Retry`.
     - `unavailable`/`signed_out` → "Khala is unavailable right now. Try again." plus `Retry`.
   - Copy never says "room" or "chat".
9. **mount.tsx**:
   - Add `case 'agent_confirm':`, which renders an `AgentConfirmRoute`. That route creates the controller with `useMemo` from `context.agentJoin`/`context.inviteAgent`, then calls `start()` and `dispose()` in an effect.
   - If either port is missing, render `<Panel heading="Agent confirmation unavailable">`.
   - `onOpenRoom` → `navigateRoute(routes.roomPath(roomId))`.
   - In `renderSignedOut`, pass `autoStart` when `routes.parse(path).kind === 'agent_confirm'`. `SignInPanel` gains `autoStart?: boolean` and calls `signIn()` once in an effect when `autoStart` is set and `signInOutcome === null`, so a cancelled or failed sign-in does not loop.

## Test scenarios

`apps/web/src/composition/human/routes.test.ts`
1. `parse('/agent/confirm?joinId=j_7Qx2')` → `{ kind: 'agent_confirm', path: '/agent/confirm?joinId=j_7Qx2', joinId: 'j_7Qx2' }`. `'/agent/confirm'`, `'/agent/confirm/j_7Qx2'`, `'/agent/confirm?joinId=a&joinId=b'`, `'/agent/confirm?joinId=x&y=1'` and `'/agent/confirm?joinId=%2F'` → `not_found`. With base path `/khala`: `agentConfirmPath('j1')` → `/khala/agent/confirm?joinId=j1`.

`apps/web/src/composition/human/browser-api.test.ts`
2. `view`: 200 valid → `ok`. 401, 403, 404 and 409 map to `signed_out`, `not_member`, `not_found` and `already_confirmed_by_other`. A malformed body → `unavailable`.
3. `confirm`: POST to `/api/human/agent-join/confirm?joinId=j1` with body `{}` and header `x-khala-csrf` set to the current token.

`apps/web/src/composition/human/matrix-browser.test.ts`
4. `inviteWithHistory`:
   - Encrypted room with no member → `invite('!r','@agent-x:hs')` is called once → `true`.
   - Member already `join` → no invite, `true`.
   - `invite` rejects → `false`.
   - Unencrypted room → `false`.

`apps/web/src/features/agent-confirm/controller.test.ts` (fake timers) — **Covers AE1 (browser leg)**
5. Happy path. The view is `pending` → `review`. `confirm()` posts once and goes to `connecting`. Status returns `confirmed` twice, then `ready`. `invite` is called once with `('!r1:khala.local', '@agent-…')`, and the controller ends in `done`.
6. Ready timeout. Status stays `confirmed` for 60 s, giving `error(ready_timeout)`. `retry()` re-polls, and the confirm POST count is still 1. Then `ready` → `done`.
7. View 403 → `error(not_member)`; `confirm()` is ignored (no POST).
8. View `confirmed`, as on a page reload, skips review and polls; it never POSTs confirm.
9. Status `expired` during the poll → `error(expired)`; polling stops (no further `status` calls after one more tick).
10. `invite` returns false → `error(invite_failed)`; `retry()` calls `invite` again and does not call `status`.
11. Confirm returns 409 → `error(already_confirmed_by_other)`.

`apps/web/src/features/agent-confirm/AgentConfirm.test.tsx`
12. Review shows label, "Claude Code" and channel name, plus a Confirm button. Connecting shows "Keep this tab open". Done and error states do not show it.

`apps/web/src/composition/human/mount.test.tsx`
13. Signed out on `/agent/confirm?joinId=j1`: `identity.beginSignIn` is called once with `'/agent/confirm?joinId=j1'` and `navigateExternal` is called with its URL. With `?sign_in=cancelled` it is not auto-called.
14. Ready context on `/agent/confirm?joinId=j1` without `agentJoin` → "Agent confirmation unavailable".

## Risks and stop conditions

- **Ordering:** this ticket edits `main.tsx`, `mount.tsx`, `routes.ts`, `browser-api.ts`, `application.ts` and `matrix-browser.ts`, which KM-120 rewrites (a dependency).
- KM-185 restyles this page later; it depends on this ticket, so no `serializes_with` edge is needed (earlier drafts listed one).
- **Stop** if KM-104's `agent-join.ts` has no runtime validator for `AgentJoinView`, or its type differs from C2 above.
- **Stop** if KM-131's `confirmUrl` is not `<origin>/agent/confirm?joinId=<joinId>`, or a `joinId` alphabet outside `[A-Za-z0-9_-]`. Do not support two paths.
- Do not add a device-verification step before invite (KTD8). Do not open a desktop browser or popup (R6).

## Complexity rationale

2: one feature folder (about 250 lines including tests) plus small additive ports. The logic is a five-state polling machine with fake-timer tests. The difficulty is wiring through the composition layers, which the steps above spell out.
